Package com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules

Class RuleRegistry

java.lang.Object
com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.RuleRegistry
public final class RuleRegistry extends Object
Thread-safe registry that stores and provides access to all AuditRule strategy implementations.

Ordering

Rules are returned in registration order, allowing callers to control execution sequence by the order in which they call register(AuditRule).

Thread safety

  • Insertion is backed by a CopyOnWriteArrayList (safe for infrequent writes, fast for frequent reads).
  • Lookup by ID uses a ConcurrentHashMap for O(1) access.
  • Both structures are kept in sync under a single write lock so that register(com.acxiom.emailaudit.rules.AuditRule) and deregister(java.lang.String) are atomic with respect to each other.

Duplicate policy

Registering a rule whose AuditRule.ruleId() is already present replaces the existing entry and logs a warning. This allows test overrides without requiring a full registry rebuild.

  • Method Details

    • register

      public void register(AuditRule rule)
      Registers rule at the end of the execution order.

      If a rule with the same AuditRule.ruleId() is already registered, it is replaced in-place (preserving its position in the ordered list) and a warning is logged.

      Parameters:
      rule - non-null rule to register
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if rule.ruleId() is null or blank

    • registerAll

      public void registerAll(List<? extends AuditRule> rules)
      Registers multiple rules in the order they appear in rules.
      Parameters:
      rules - non-null, non-empty list of rules

      Returns:
      true if a rule was found and removed

    • getEnabledRules

      public List<AuditRule> getEnabledRules()
      Returns all enabled rules in registration order.

      The returned list is an unmodifiable snapshot; subsequent registrations do not affect it.

      Returns:
      unmodifiable list of enabled rules; never null
